about: I'm a fourth-semester Computer Science & Engineering undergraduate at the Islamic University of Technology, Dhaka — the OIC's university, sitting on the edge of the capital.

I build things that have to hold up when it matters. A donor-matching engine for emergency blood requests. A chat protocol that pushes instead of polls. A cache controller drawn as a state machine and made to run.

I'm heading toward platform engineering - the layer underneath, the part nobody notices until it stops. Alongside that I'm building Android with Flutter, exploring the fundamentals of machine learning, and aspiring to dive deeper into graphics design.
Before any of that I was a photographer, a magazine editor, and a kid who read too much. None of that went away.
